{{Quote|What in stars kinda ship is this? It looks like an ore carrier!''"<br />"''That's because it ''is'' an ore carrier.|A [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] refugee and another refugee regarding the ore carrier on Arkinnea|<ref name="FireCarrier2">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 2|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Ore carriers''' were a type of [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] utilized to carry [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. At least one was capable of dropping its cargo out of hatches under its hull. One such carrier was utilized by the [[Arkinnea Militia]] on [[Arkinnea]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[Death/Legends|massacre]] refugees, though it was brought down by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]]. The vessels were also used on [[Lazerian IV]].

==Characteristics==
Ore carriers were a variety of [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]].<ref name="TSoK" /> At least one ore carrier had a hatch below its hull, which allowed it to drop any cargo held inside of it. Its chassis was orange, white, and gray in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="FireCarrier3" />

==Role==
Ore carriers were traditionally used to carry [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="TSoK" /> However, the [[Arkinnea Militia]] utilized the carriers to hold refugees, which they then dropped from extreme heights using the carrier's hatches to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them.<ref name="FireCarrier3" />

==History==
Ore carriers were among the few [[Starship/Legends|starships]] permitted to land in and depart from the [[Industrial Starport]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]].<ref name="TSoK" /> By around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="FireCarrierDate">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]] states that its events take place a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III 'Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. As such, the events of ''Dark Times&mdash;Fire Carrier'' 1 must take place around 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> one ore carrier was under the command of the Arkinnea Militia, a local military group from [[Arkinnea]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="FireCarrier1" />

===Hope on Arkinnea===
{{Quote|There's plenty of room for everyone. No need to push. Have your datachips ready.|Captain Relik guiding refugees onto the ore carrier|<ref name="FireCarrier2" />}}
[[File:RefugeesOreCarrier.png|thumb|left|200px|Refugees board the ore carrier on Arkinnea]]
Around 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="FireCarrierDate" /> while in a [[Arkinnea refugee camp|refugee camp]] alongside a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Chase Piru]] was given a [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] that would light up when it was their turn to board the ore carrier that would allegedly ferry the refugees north. The group soon encountered Jedi Master [[Zao]], who informed them of a great danger in the camp that they needed to escape from.<ref name="FireCarrier1" /> That night, the Jedi Masters had the younglings and Piru gather their belongings and prepare to escape the camp. K'Kruhk discovered the datachip Piru was given, and tossed it decide, declaring they would not need it.<ref name="FireCarrier2" />

The morning after, the refugees of the camp slowly began to board the ore carrier, and one [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] commented on the state of the vessel. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Relik (individual)|Relik]] of the Arkinnea Militia apologized to the refugee, stating that the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had stretched their economy thin and it was the best accommodations they could provide. Another member of the Arkinnea Militia then approached Relik as the refugees boarded, informing [[Gender/Legends|him]] that their forces could not locate K'Kruhk and his group. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] refugee boarding the ship then commented that she had seen them sneak out late at night. Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Teron]] asked Relik about the situation, to which the captain responded they were just searching for refugees who had failed to board the ore carrier. As the ore carrier took off, Relik was informed via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that the datachip belonging to K'Kruhk's group had been located.<ref name="FireCarrier2" />

===Massacre on Arkinnea===
[[File:OreCarrierCrash.png|thumb|right|200px|K'Kruhk flees from the exploding ore carrier.]]
Meanwhile, K'Kruhk's group began to set out for an [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|abandoned temple]] on the planet, where they would create a shelter for themselves. While doing so, Master Zao spotted the ore carrier flying overhead, disturbing him. While traveling there, the group then found a pile of corpses&mdash;the refugees that had been dropped to their deaths by the carrier.<ref name="FireCarrier2" /> As they observed the masses of dead refugees, Piru urged the youngling [[Sidirri]] not to look. Identifying the refugees as denizens of the refugee camp, K'Kruhk and Zao tried [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] any survivors through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to no avail. Piru pleaded with Master Zao, asking why the Arkinnea Militia would be killing refugees. Zao replied that the militia never had any intention of relocating them, and only wanted revenge on their former enemies from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FireCarrier3" />

Youngling [[Kennan Taanzer]] commented that, had their group boarded the ore carrier, they would have died as well. As the group then prepared to leave, they watched in horror as the ore carrier returned and began to drop more refugees to their deaths. The Jedi watching had the memory of this event seared into their minds as if it had taken place over the course of [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] rather than [[Standard second|seconds]]. Meanwhile, Arkinnea Militia [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Makos]] was asked by his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] if there were only clingers, only for him to instead spot the group Jedi, identifying them as witnesses. As K'Kruhk's group began to escape, a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the carrier ordered a group of troopers to the deck, where they opened fire on the Jedi.<ref name="FireCarrier3" />

The Jedi fleed into a nearby grove of [[Tree/Legends|trees]], prompting the ore carrier to swing back around to gain an advantageous position. Once the carrier was over the grove, K'Kruhk began to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] it down using the Force, which the pilots were incapable of preventing. As Captain Relik arrived in another ship, he watched as the carrier hit the ground, exploding as K'Kruhk fled.<ref name="FireCarrier3" /> After the ore carrier's destruction, Relik ordered his men to fan out and search for the Jedi who witnessed the massacre of refugees.<ref name="FireCarrier4">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 4|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ore carriers were created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" /> They were first depicted in [[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 2|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 2]],<ref name="FireCarrier2" /> the twenty-fourth issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' comic series published on [[March 6]], [[2013]].<ref name="MarvelFC2">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54094/star_wars_dark_times_-_fire_carrier_2013_2|text=Star Wars: Dark Times - Fire Carrier (2013) #2}}</ref> In the [[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 4|fourth issue]] of the same series<ref name="FireCarrier4" />&mdash;published [[May 1]], [[2013]]<ref name="MarvelFC4">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54096/star_wars_dark_times_-_fire_carrier_2013_4|text=Star Wars: Dark Times - Fire Carrier (2013) #4}}</ref>&mdash;the ore carrier used by the Arkinnea Militia is depicted with four gray dome-like protrusions on its upper hull in most panels. However, the panel depicting its crash only depicts three such protrusions.<ref name="FireCarrier4" />
